resources.string: Welcome! This electronic dictionary contains approximately 1,500 Mathematical terms in English and Uzbek. The dictionary is compiled by Kurbanova Husniya, a PhD student at Gulistan State university

The content of dictionary is developed by Husniya Kurbanova, PhD student at Gulistan State university. The author mainly used "Russian-English Mathematical dictionary" compiled by Ya. I. Mishiev to collect English base

Xush kelibsiz! Mazkur mobil lug\'at ingliz va o\'zbek tillaridagi 1,500 ga yaqin matematik terminlarni o\'z ichiga olgan. Lug\'at Guliston davlat universiteti tayanch doktoranti Kurbanova Husniya tomonidan tuzildi.
